services.name: Brand Kit Generation
services.description: Full brand identity extraction and deliverable package from a website, brand name, or existing assets. Includes color palette, typography, logo usage rules, and style guide.
typical_inclusions: Primary and secondary color palette with hex/RGB values
Logo usage guidelines and spacing rules
Tone of voice and messaging guidelines
Delivery in Markdown, HTML, and YAML formats

services.name: Website Design & Development
services.description: Design and build of a responsive website or landing page using taste-driven frontend principles. Anti-slop design with premium visual quality.
typical_inclusions: Design brief intake and aesthetic alignment
exclusions: Custom form handling or database logic

services.name: Instagram Carousel Content
services.description: Generation of a complete Instagram carousel post with hook slide, content slides, CTA slide, caption options, and hashtag sets.
typical_inclusions: 3-7 content slides with structured information flow
CTA slide with clear next step
Hashtag set tailored to topic and audience
Markdown-formatted carousel ready for design tool import

services.name: Tax Client Intake System
services.description: Automated pre-appointment intake workflow for individual tax clients (1040 filers). Collects documents, runs OCR, generates organizer PDFs, and integrates with HubSpot/Google Sheets.
typical_inclusions: OCR extraction via Google Cloud Vision or Veryfi
Filing status conflict detection vs. prior year
HubSpot custom object integration (Google Sheets fallback)

services.name: Google Workspace Automation
services.description: Setup and automation of Google Workspace tasks via gws CLI — file management, email workflows, calendar automation, spreadsheet operations, and Chat messaging.
typical_inclusions: Google Sheets creation and data pipelines
